question: What effect on death by aging follows from abstaining from food by day?
premises: Death by age is named as the object
inference: By abstaining from food during the day, one will go to death by age rather than premature death.
uncertainties: The exact sense of gamiṣyate with vayo-mṛtyuṃ is somewhat compressed and interpretive.
plain_english: By abstaining from food during the day, one will reach death only through old age.
